name: Date Kazuhiko
source: An elite employee of Takamiya Software, who is a pretty nasty guy. An easy-to-understand person who marries [url=/c84797]Takamiya Shouko[/url] and aims to be an executive. Kazuhiko has a short temper, he is a small-minded person who later tries calmly to repair the distraught he had caused.
